study.name: Prior preferences interfere with the associative learning of food values
study.citation: Rich, A., Kapadia, S., Henry, R., Dan, O., & Levy, I. (2026). Prior preferences interfere with the associative learning of food values. Research Square. https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.rs-8651706/v1

description: Collected online via Prolific. Participants rated 65 food images on a five-point Likert scale (1 = Strongly Dislike, 5 = Strongly Like); every subject rated every item. Stimuli are a subset of the Columbia FoodFolio image set. The source files flag 65 of the 395 subjects as invalid on a rating-variance criterion; all 395 are retained here, so anyone reproducing the paper's analyses should apply that screen themselves.
